handoff_mode: Original SDK history in one durable session per arm; automatic session handoff disabled equally. ChatGPT real continuation is tested directly without claiming prior handoff admission.
fairness_limitations: Distinct native Provider wire parameters and output limits; scientific instructions, domain, tools and resource counts are held equal.
Single sequential trajectory per model is descriptive evidence, not a statistical model-quality ranking.
continuation_rule: Inspect the first four shared requests. Continue within the same original ledger when a valid scientific action occurred or there is concrete progress toward one. Stop repeated reading/routing when the complete required domain and schema are already available. Any error or unknown Provider outcome stops that arm without retry or model replacement.
source_store: Stopped P4 is read-only; its remaining request and grant are never reused.
scientific_scope: Original M5/BF5 and FamilySpace; per arm at most two mathematical evaluations, two physical launches and original native caps. No PPO, new solvers, or relaxed acceptance.
